MappingFields.Name: EmployeeId
MappingFields.Description:
[Required]
The Ultimo employee the user belongs to. Create stops when it is empty. Only mapped for Create, because it cannot be updated.

MappingFields.Name: UserId
MappingFields.Description:
[Required]
The Ultimo user Id, also used as the correlation field. Only mapped for Create, because it cannot be updated: after Create the AccountReference is used.

MappingFields.Name: ExternalAccountName
MappingFields.Description:
[Optional]
The name of the user for external authentication. Defaults to the userPrincipalName. Customer-specific: adjust Person.Accounts.MicrosoftActiveDirectory to the name of the customer's Active Directory target system.

MappingFields.Name: UserDescription
MappingFields.Description:
[Required]
The description of the user, required by the UpdateUser action. Complex mapping that generates the display name from the name convention.

MappingFields.Name: GroupId
MappingFields.Description:
[Required]
The Ultimo Configuration Group. Create stops when it is empty. Mapped for Create by default. It can also be mapped for Update, but that replaces the configuration group of existing users and can cause them to lose rights, so only do this consciously, see the README. The example maps a title code to a Configuration Group, with a fallback for all other titles.
